name: wellness-breaks
description: While Claude works, reminds you to stand up, drink water, stretch, and do lunges or squats.

waitSeconds.title: Wait before nudging (seconds)
waitSeconds.description: How long Claude must be working before a break is suggested. 1 to 3600; an invalid value uses the default.

intervalMinutes.title: Reminder interval (minutes)
intervalMinutes.description: Also remind you this often, even if Claude is idle. 0 turns it off; otherwise 1 to 1440. An invalid value uses the default.
